input: Sign up for a beginner's yoga class

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Whether the class is in-person or online completely changes where to look, how to sign up, and what equipment or space is needed.
The style of yoga (Hatha, Vinyasa, Yin, etc.) narrows the search and determines which classes are actually appropriate for their goals.
The preferred day/time availability determines which specific classes are even viable options.
A budget limit rules in or out certain studios, apps, or subscription services and shapes which sign-up options to prioritise.
Knowing whether this is for themselves alone or with someone else (e.g., a friend, partner) affects class type, timing, and booking logistics.
A preference for class size or setting (large studio, small boutique, one-on-one) affects which venue or platform to target.
Understanding the underlying goal (stress relief, fitness, flexibility, social) ensures the chosen class genuinely serves what they want to get out of it.

gold.taskTitle: Sign up for a beginner's yoga class
gold.taskDescription: Find and enrol in a beginner-level yoga class that fits the user's situation.

questions.title: Do you want an in-person or online class?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants to attend a local studio or participate virtually, as this dictates the entire search and sign-up process.

questions.title: Which style of yoga are you interested in?
questions.description: Identify if the user has a preference for a specific style (e.g., Hatha, Vinyasa, Yin, Restorative) to narrow down suitable beginner classes.

questions.title: Which days and times work best for you?
questions.description: Establish the user's weekly schedule and availability so only realistic class slots are considered.

questions.title: What is your budget per class or per month?
questions.description: Understand the financial limit to filter out unaffordable options and prioritise free, low-cost, or premium classes accordingly.

questions.title: Are you signing up alone or with someone else?
questions.description: Find out if the user is joining solo or with a friend or partner, which may influence class choice and whether a group deal is needed.

questions.title: Do you prefer a small intimate class or a larger group?
questions.description: Gauge the user's comfort level and social preference to match them with the right studio size or class format.

questions.title: What is your main goal for doing yoga?
questions.description: Clarify the primary motivation — such as stress relief, improved flexibility, fitness, or social connection — to ensure the class type truly serves their needs.
